messages:
Sam: heads up — deploy-bot flagged the canary promotion as failed in staging, artifact verify checksum mismatch during promote. anyone seeing this elsewhere?

deploy-bot: Promotion failed for service `redwood-service:canary-20260301` -> registry verify mismatch. expected sha256=abc12345... got sha256=def67890...
logs:
```
remote: HEAD -> upload
verifier: expecting sha256:abc12345...
verifier: observed sha256:def67890...
error: artifact metadata TTL expired during index lookup (http 412)
```
Maria: I noticed the artifact indexer ran a reindex around 17:00 UTC, might be a TTL/regeneration race. no one pushed this tag again AFAIK.

Raj: Confirmed — CI build job 8251 uploaded the artifact once. indexer reindexed and bumped TTL, then the promote attempted against stale metadata. looks like a race between registry-object TTL and index snapshot.

Sam: OK. Proposal: pin canary to the last-good digest and re-run promote. If promote still fails, rollback canary back to previous stable digest.

Maria: I can pin and re-promote. last-good digest from successful smoke run is `sha256:abc12345deadbeef`. I'll run the deploybot promote command.

Maria: Running:
```
deploybot promote --service redwood-service --image redwood-service@sha256:abc12345deadbeef --env canary --reason "pin-last-good-after-checksum-mismatch" --notify slack:eng-releases
```

ci-bot: Triggered pipeline #8264 for promote (canary). status: queued.

Raj: Also recommend we block the full release cut until we verify other images. Suggest putting a release hold and scheduling a short hotfix/change window at 16:30 PST to audit indexer TTL settings.

ops-oncall: ack, putting a release hold tag on the release board. I'll also add a PagerDuty note if this repeats.

Sam: Good. Maria — after promote, run the canary smoke tests (the quick endpoint and latency checks). If green, we can unblock. If flaky, rollback.

Maria: Promote succeeded. deploy-bot: Promotion completed for redwood-service@sha256:abc12345deadbeef -> canary.

ci-bot: Smoke pipeline #8264 started. tests: quick-smoke, latency-check, sanity.

Maria: Smoke tests passed (all green). latency + error rate within thresholds.

Sam: Great. Unblock? I'd still like a follow-up ticket to increase index TTL and add a short delay/retry for registry verify in deploybot.

Raj: I'll file the ticket: INF-1432 "Indexer TTL race causing checksum mismatch during promote" and assign to infra-team. Plan: increase TTL to 24h and add 3 retry attempts with backoff in deploy flow.

Maria: Added a short note to the release notes: "Canary briefly paused due to artifact index TTL mismatch; pinned to last-good digest and promoted — no user impact."

ops-oncall: release hold removed, marking as manually unblocked. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks everyone. We'll monitor canary for the next 60m then proceed with normal promote to staging if stable.
